data.title: Bitcoin’s Q4 Selloff Could End Quickly, Analyst Says: ‘This Is the Bottoming Window’
data.description: Bitcoin’s CRYPTO:BTCUSD current Q4 selloff could resolve quickly, analyst Benjamin Cowen says, pointing to historical patterns where similar drops ended within days or weeks.Why Cowen Sees Two Possible Paths From HereCowen said on his YouTube update on Friday that Bitcoin could play out one of two…
